title: callista ciliata
intro: Callista ciliata, commonly known as the Bird's Eye or Bird's Eye Chamomile, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and insomnia, and it has been used in traditional medicine to soothe digestive issues and calm the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Callista ciliata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
